title: Spring-Gate Bottle-Neck Clip with Webbing Slot
description: A C-ring that snaps onto a 27-28 mm bottle neck or flask neck and hangs from 25 mm webbing (pack strap, belt, bike frame loop). The ring arms flex outward like a carabiner gate - flat print, no hardware.
use: Keep a drinking bottle reachable on a backpack strap or tent loop: clip the ring on the neck, thread webbing through the slot. Pull straight off to release.
material: PETG or nylon, 0.2 mm layers, 5 perimeters, printed flat. PLA is too brittle for the arm flex.
mechanism_tests: PASS | gate opens 3.5 deg per arm and lets a 28.50 mm neck pass (swept at 8 positions, overlap 0)
PASS | open gate: neck at x=46 clears the arms: overlap 0.000 mm3 (must be 0)
PASS | open gate: neck at x=30 clears the arms: overlap 0.000 mm3 (must be 0)
PASS | open gate: neck at x=18 clears the arms: overlap 0.000 mm3 (must be 0)
PASS | open gate: neck at x=6 clears the arms: overlap 0.000 mm3 (must be 0)
PASS | open gate: neck at x=0 clears the arms: overlap 0.000 mm3 (must be 0)
PASS | closed gate resists a neck pushed in at x=14 (snap needs force): overlap 1.490 mm3 (stop/latch must engage, >0)
PASS | closed ring seats around the neck (0.15 mm radial slack): overlap 0.000 mm3 (must be 0)
PASS | arm flex: t=3.6 mm, L=25.7 mm, tip travel 1.57 mm -> peak strain 1.3 % (PETG/nylon ok below ~4 %; PLA fails)
PASS | webbing slot 3.4 x 27 mm: passes 25 mm x 1.5 mm webbing with 1 mm side play; end walls 1.5 mm
problem_solved: Bottles with a plain neck have no hook or loop, so they ride loose in a side pocket and fall out when you scramble or bend. A snap-on neck gate lets you hang the bottle from any strap without buying a bottle-specific accessory.
mechanism: C-shaped ring with two flexure arms that spring open at the root like a carabiner gate; a webbing slot block is molded to the ring; the one-piece print needs no hinge pin.
tolerances: Ring bore 28.8 mm vs 28.5 mm neck (0.15 mm radial slack); gate mouth 24 mm closed opens to neck diameter; flex strain below 4 %; slot 3.4 x 27 mm.
assembly: 2. Press the ring mouth onto the bottle neck below the cap ridge until it snaps shut.
fit_notes: Sized for 27-28.5 mm necks. Not a life-safety or climbing device. Try a test fit before printing a batch.
